rows.name: Hall Effect/Rapid Trigger
rows.note: For a second straight week, Wooting's own timeline points to late-October delivery with no public confirmation that ABS/Module units have actually shipped yet.

rows.name: Cherry MX2A
rows.note: No new MX2A catalyst again this week — the slow sentiment recovery from last year's scratch complaints remains stalled with no fresh SKU or review in sight.

rows.name: TMR (Tunnel Magnetoresistance) switches
rows.note: Keychron's V6 Ultra Hybrid TMR campaign keeps tracking toward its November 2026 ship window, with press coverage still citing a strong early pledge total.

rows.name: Gateron Magnetic Jade Delta
rows.note: Jade Delta remains a fulfillment-queue item on vendor storefronts with roughly the same multi-month lead time; no new SKU or colorway surfaced this week.

rows.name: Gateron Oil King
rows.note: No restock or vendor push found this week; Oil King continues to hold its spot as a steady budget-flagship linear with unchanged availability.

rows.name: Durock T1
rows.note: Existing colorway lineup remains unchanged this week; no group buy or vendor campaign has revived attention for this switch.

rows.name: GMK CYL Red Devils R2
rows.note: Three weeks post-close, the set still hasn't resurfaced on vendor listings or secondary-market threads, extending its drop from current attention.

rows.name: GMK CYL Zombie
rows.note: Vendor listings still show Zombie at interest-check stage with a waiting list; the group buy hasn't opened even as the expected Oct 2-31 window closes without one.

rows.name: DCS Dolch / Molch
rows.note: Divinikey still lists Dolch as preorder with an October 2026 estimated ship window, while the related Molch run continues pointing to Q1 2027.

rows.name: Split/Ergo layout
rows.note: MoErgo's Go60 Golden Kiwi switch option remains the freshest story, though fulfillment-date pages still show conflicting estimates across different SKUs.

rows.name: Alice layout
rows.note: Epomaker Tide Alice reviews continue trickling in while Qwertykeys' QK Alice Duo supply situation stays unclear, leaving fresh-supply momentum flat.

rows.name: 75% Layout
rows.note: No credible update surfaced from Mode's own channels this week; only unverified third-party marketing content hints at tight Sonnet 2 supply.

rows.name: CannonKeys
rows.note: Blaine V2: SE's fulfillment ETA grew murkier this week — a reseller listing quotes Q1 2027 while CannonKeys' own add-ons page still shows an older Q4 2026 figure.

rows.name: Mode Designs
rows.note: Sonnet and Encore remain in a post-group-buy fulfillment lull, with Encore's summer shipment already out the door; no new restock or teaser this week.

rows.name: Prototypist
rows.note: Geonworks' GMK CYL MONO group buy is confirmed to open Oct 30 through Nov 30, keeping Prototypist's UK-proxy listing volume elevated into next month.

rows.name: Keychron
rows.note: Q16 HE 8K shows scattered regional stockouts on some color variants while other warehouses fulfill normally; the V6 Ultra Hybrid TMR Kickstarter still tracks its November window.

rows.name: Wooting
rows.note: 80HE+ ABS/Module deliveries are still slated for late October per Wooting's own timeline, but no public confirmation of first units shipping has surfaced yet.

rows.name: ZMK firmware
rows.note: No dated ZMK firmware release surfaced this week; MoErgo's Go60 Golden Kiwi option remains the freshest related story, itself unchanged since last week.
